entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On perusal of the averments made in the F.I.R and forwarding report along with the documents annexed therewith it appears that the age of the victim girl on the date of marriage was 17 years and as such, this Court is of the considered opinion that further continuation of detention of the accused petitioner in the interest of the ongoing investigation is not warranted.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest, the petitioner, named above, shall be released on pre-arrest bail, in connection with the above noted case on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 30,000/-
with one local surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject, of course,
to the following conditions:
(i) That the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 7 days;
failing which on and from the 8 th day, the pre- arrest bail order shall automatically come to end;
(ii) That the petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court; and (iii) That the petitioner shall refrain from committing any Page No.# 3/3 similar offence in future of which he is accused or suspected of commission.
This disposes off the anticipatory bail application.
JUDGE
